synthetic_identification_note: Product identification, serial number, model code (16000), version numbers, build time, and all electrical/thermal measurements are synthetic deterministic values generated strictly for offline/simulator testing.
string_upper_byte_test_note: Registers 0x0021..0x0034 and 0x0035..0x0048 intentionally populate non-zero upper bytes (0xA5, 0x3C, 0x7E, 0xFF) on ASCII character words to verify lower-8-bits-per-word masking (word & 0x00FF) per SRNE Modbus V2.04 p9.

scenarios.title: Normal solar production with battery charging
scenarios.description: Daytime inverter operation with 8,428 W PV generation supplying 3,450 W split-phase load and charging the 48V battery at 85.0 A (-4,556 W net discharge sign convention).

scenarios.title: Battery discharging and supplying inverter output
scenarios.description: Evening inverter operation with zero PV generation, battery discharging at +75.0 A (+3,840 W) to supply 3,470 W split-phase output.

scenarios.title: Utility operation with solar production at zero
scenarios.description: Grid bypass operation supplying 2,420 W split-phase load while AC utility charger supplies 30.0 A constant-voltage battery charge (-1,572 W net battery power).

scenarios.title: Standby operation
scenarios.description: Idle standby mode with zero output power, full battery (100% SOC), grid-connection countdown active (60 s), and sub-zero ambient temperature (-2.5 degC) exercising signed16 temperature decoding.

scenarios.title: Active fault indication
scenarios.description: Protective fault state in split-phase standby with non-zero fault slots (0x0204=1, 0x0205=20), zero AC output, high heatsink temperatures (up to 82.1 degC), and manufacturer password status (4).
